difficulty.bottleneck: All 82 proof checkpoints enumerate every currently productive full-support row and column. Before cleanup at <=12 unresolved cells, at least 10 productive lines were available; no three-step run met the <=2-lines/<=4-changed-cells bottleneck condition in this path. This does not validate an exhaustive weaker-rule analyser.
difficulty.calibration: No human calibration data and no validated difficulty analyser; low-confidence editorial estimate.

rule_families.R0: Seven rows (10–16) and seven columns (10–16), one-based, are fully packed immediately. Rows 12/13 [19 body,5 dark] and column 12 [20 body,4 dark] give broad exact anchors; late remaining cells are routine cleanup. R0 alone was not exhaustively tested to fixpoint.
rule_families.R1: Estimated main demand: overlap and extension of the large body/highlight/shade blocks against these central anchors; outer empty corners follow from bounded blocks. This wide distribution of simple anchors supports L2 rather than rating by 576-cell size.
rule_families.R2: Some right/upper boundary color-run combinations and partial domains may require combined assignment; necessity and sufficiency of the weaker families were not exhaustively established, hence L1–L3 uncertainty.
rule_families.R3: The full-line-color certificate uses general support (including partial color exclusions), but that does not prove R3 is necessary. No specific unavoidable R3 step was identified in the editorial examination.
